verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a durable-execution platform, for example cancelling or killing many invocations at once. The evidence never documents such a capability. The CLI is described only as managing 'services, deployments and invocations', with nothing about acting on many at once. The fan-out and parallel tool-call patterns are developer building blocks for writing parallel code, not a product bulk-operation feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
